coreAtributes.authorTag: "Tailored by the DSG Textile Guild" is crudely sewn into the fabric near the side seam
coreAtributes.name: roughspun tunic
coreAtributes.description: A tunic made from roughspun wool, cinched about the waist with a leather belt. Although it reaches down to the wearer's thighs, movement is not impeded thanks to partial slits cut into the sides. A small pouch is attached to the belt for handy storage. The fabric is threadbare despite still being whole.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] pull on the tunic. [npc.She] then securely fasten the belt around [npc.namePos] waist.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] help [npc2.name] [npc2.verb(put)] [npc2.her] arms through the tunic's sleeves as [npc.she] pull the rest down over [npc2.her] torso. [npc.She] then securely fasten the belt around [npc2.namePos] waist.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] stuff [npc2.name] [npc2.verb(put)] [npc2.her] arms into the tunic's sleeves as [npc.she] roughly pull the rest down over [npc2.her] torso. [npc.She] then yanks the belt around [npc2.namePos] waist and cinch it up as tightly as possible.
